summary: Frontend-only testing for LUDO OPS admin panel (Expo web preview + Firebase RTDB). All 7 scenarios in the review request passed: (1) Live tab renders match card #482913 with all 4 players, LIVE badge, CONNECTED pill; (2) tapping card opens match control screen with recent dice roll chips, TURN badge on red (Anondo), progress % per player; (3) force-dice-green-6 writes matches/482913/control/force/green=6 and toggles back to 0 on second tap (verified via curl); (4) rank1-red + rank2-blue + apply writes control.rank1='red' & control.rank2='blue', shows toast 'Manipulation applied...', and Live card then displays MANIPULATION ACTIVE badge; (5) clear-manipulation-button removes matches/482913/control (curl GET returns null); (6) realtime PATCH of state.currentTurn from red->green instantly moved TURN badge to Rahim (green) with no reload; (7) History tab shows row #111222 with 1ST TestA, and the finished match is not shown on Live tab. Cleanup done: state.currentTurn reset to red, control removed, matches/111222 deleted. No React Native red-screen or console errors observed (only a benign warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' from an internal RN-web dependency).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' emitted on load. Likely from a transitive dependency (Ionicons/react-native-web) rather than app code. Reference: browser console during navigation to /.

action_items: No action needed for functional flow - all 7 acceptance criteria pass end-to-end against Firebase RTDB.
Minor: The pointerEvents deprecation warning originates from a library. Consider upgrading react-native / react-native-web / @expo/vector-icons if the noise is undesired; not blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: match/[id].tsx line 41-53: The onValue subscription depends on [id] but uses 'synced' state inside the callback without re-subscribing; this is intentional (sync form once) and works but eslint-disable is correctly placed.

history.tsx: When Firebase returns winners as an array (because keys are numeric strings like '1', '2'), Object.entries yields ['0', null] as first entry (index 0 is null for winners starting at 1). Current code handles it gracefully because sort by Number(a) and slice(0,2) with truthy check via w.name || w.color still renders. Verified: row shows '1ST TestA' correctly. Not a bug in practice but worth noting.
index.tsx line 42: 'live' filter uses m.status === 'live' which correctly excludes finished/abandoned matches - verified.
firebase.ts: initialization uses env vars properly with EXPO_PUBLIC_ prefix - good.
seed_data_creation: Created matches/111222 (finished match with winner TestA) via curl PUT for history test; deleted during cleanup. Reset matches/482913/state.currentTurn to 'red' and removed matches/482913/control node.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Firebase RTDB seed match #482913 must remain live (status='live') with players Anondo(red)/Rahim(green)/Karim(yellow)/Jamal(blue). control node is currently removed; state.currentTurn='red'. Test flow: Live -> match card -> force dice / manipulation / clear -> history tab. Use EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env for the preview URL. All testIDs listed in review_request work correctly.
